content: Webhook auth differs per forge. GitHub: HMAC-SHA256 hex digest of body in X-Hub-Signature-256, constant-time compare, X-GitHub-Delivery GUID for idempotency. GitLab historically sends the plaintext secret in X-Gitlab-Token (weaker, no payload integrity); since v19 GitLab also supports Standard Webhooks HMAC-SHA256 with Webhook-Id/Webhook-Timestamp/Webhook-Signature, signature takes precedence when both present. Gitea/Forgejo have their own scheme (X-Gitea-Signature HMAC-SHA256) and a known bug class where receivers do not validate before processing. All forges are at-least-once: dedupe on provider event id inside the same transaction as the state update, and record processed BEFORE side effects.
